ACTIVE_CONSOLES.description: Device files of virtual terminals to configure, e.g., /dev/tty[1-6] (Linux) or /dev/ttyv[0-8] (FreeBSD); may be 'guess'.

CHARMAP.description: Desired console encoding; valid values: UTF-8, ARMSCII-8, CP1251, ..., VISCII, or 'guess'.

CODESET.description: Font codeset: small (Armenian, CyrAsia, ..., Thai) or big (Arabic, Uni1, ..., Vietnamese); 'guess' recommended.

FONTFACE.description: Font face: VGA, Terminus, TerminusBold, TerminusBoldVGA, Fixed, Goha, GohaClassic (if CODESET=Ethiopian).

FONTSIZE.description: Font size: e.g., '8x8', '8x14', '8x16', '16x28', '16x32'; must match FONTFACE and platform.

VIDEOMODE.description: Video mode string (e.g., 'vga=791') or empty to skip video mode configuration.

FONT.description: List of font file paths (space-separated in config) for custom fonts.

FONT_MAP.description: Path to external font map file (Linux only, for fonts without embedded Unicode map).

CONSOLE_MAP.description: Path to console translation map (Linux only).

SCREEN_WIDTH.description: Screen width in characters (e.g., 80), enforced via stty(1).

SCREEN_HEIGHT.description: Screen height in rows (e.g., 25), enforced via stty(1).
